# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa LLC is a simulation lab for machines and AI agents that have to run on their own. Its thesis: autonomy is cheap, trust isn't. Systems are broken in simulation, proven with evidence a person can read, and only then allowed to run unattended. Founder: Sepehr Aflatounian (https://sepehrafla.github.io). Contact: contact@leyoxa.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://leyoxa.com/index.md): the thesis, the ladder of autonomy, the method and the founder.
